name: Botanischer Garten der Universität Innsbruck
kurzbeschreibung: The Botanical Garden of Innsbruck University in Hötting: Over two hectares of alpine and tropical plant diversity, greenhouses, and a fragrant herb garden.
beschreibung:
Overview

The historic Botanical Garden of the University of Innsbruck is nestled in the sunny district of Hötting at the foot of the Nordkette range in Tyrol's state capital Innsbruck (Innsbruck region) at an altitude of approximately 600 meters. Established between 1909 and 1913 as the successor to the earlier university garden in the city center, the heritage-protected grounds span more than two hectares of park-like grounds. Serving as a scientific research and educational facility for the Institute of Botany, this lush oasis combines international species conservation, cutting-edge botanical research, and tranquil recreation within the urban fabric.

Alpinum, Greenhouses & Plant Collections

The garden is home to over 5,000 distinct plant species from diverse climatic zones across the globe. Its crowning jewel is the expansive Alpinum: constructed on limestone and siliceous rock beds, it showcases the extraordinary resilience of high-alpine flora from the Alps, Carpathians, Caucasus, and Himalayas, featuring rare edelweiss varieties, gentians, dwarf shrubs, and primroses. In the historic and modern display greenhouses, visitors step into exotic climate zones: tropical rainforest houses with orchids, bromeliads, and giant tree ferns contrast with arid desert houses teeming with rare succulents and cacti. A comprehensive medicinal herb garden grouped by active ingredients, a dedicated sensory garden for the visually impaired, and a natural fern pond round out this horticultural gem.

Visit & Getting There

The outdoor park grounds of the Botanical Garden are open daily year-round from 07:30 to 19:00 (in winter until dusk; display greenhouses open Mon–Thu 10:00–15:00 and Fri 10:00–13:00). Admission to the outdoor botanical grounds is free; a modest maintenance contribution of approx. €3.00 is charged for the greenhouses. Getting there: The garden is located at Sternwartestraße 15 in Hötting. From the city center / Marktplatz, it is about a 15-minute walk uphill via Höttinger Gasse to the main entrance. By public transport (IVB): Bus route H travels directly from the main railway station to the Botanischer Garten stop right outside the gate. Limited short-term parking is available along Sternwartestraße.

Tips

The primary circular pathways through the outdoor gardens and the greenhouses are barrier-free and fully wheelchair-accessible. In spring, during the blooming peak of the alpine rock-garden species and rhododendrons, the garden displays a spectacular array of colors. Don't miss the historic, listed University Observatory located within the park, and take time to unwind on the peaceful shaded benches.
